title: ARAC: Benchmarking Auto-Research's Alignment and Completeness on End-to-End Researchs
abstract: arXiv:2608.12788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid advancement of Auto-Research has surfaced a fundamental evaluation challenge: how can we measure the alignment, logical coherence, and evolutionary completeness of its research trajectory with human research behavior? We propose Auto-Research's Alignment and Completeness, ARAC-Bench: a Researcher-Mimicking Evaluation framework that shifts the objective from matching final answers to reproducing high-quality human research processes. The framework operates through two synergistic components: the Academic Cognition Skills system, which is the first to transforms implicit reviewer expertise into stage-calibrated, quantifiable rubrics; and a three-stage capability diagnostic protocol, which decomposes the research process under strict modular constraints into three traceable, mutually independent dimensions: Proposal, Experiment, and Synthesis. Systematic evaluation of 11 SOTA frameworks yields a best alignment score of only 67.9 o

translated_title: ARAC：端到端研究自动化研究的一致性与完整性基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12788v1 公告类型：新 摘要：自动化研究的快速发展引发了一个基础性的评估挑战：我们如何衡量其研究轨迹与人类研究行为的一致性、逻辑连贯性和演化完整性？我们提出了自动化研究的一致性与完整性基准——ARAC-Bench：一个模仿研究者的评估框架，将目标从匹配最终答案转向复现高质量的人类研究过程。该框架通过两个协同组件运作：学术认知技能系统，这是首个将隐性审稿专家知识转化为阶段校准、可量化评分标准的方法；以及一个三阶段能力诊断协议，该协议在严格模块化约束下将研究过程分解为三个可追踪、相互独立的维度：提案、实验和综合。对11个最先进框架的系统评估显示，最佳一致性得分仅为67.9分。
tldr: 该论文提出了ARAC-Bench框架，首次将审稿专家知识转化为可量化评分标准，并通过三阶段诊断协议评估自动化研究过程与人类研究行为的一致性，发现当前最先进框架的最佳一致性得分仅为67.9分。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ARAC-Bench, a framework that first transforms reviewer expertise into quantifiable rubrics and evaluates auto-research alignment with human research processes via a three-stage diagnostic protocol, revealing the best alignment score of only 67.9 among 11 SOTA frameworks.
